title: IncrementDET: Continual AI-Generated Music Detection via Enrollment
abstract: arXiv:2611.32023v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI-generated music has become common on music streaming platforms, and listeners often cannot distinguish it from music made by humans. AI-music detection is therefore needed, but detectors trained on a fixed set of generators often fail on unseen generators. As new generators emerge frequently, updating a universal detector, a single model for all generators, typically requires substantial training data and computation, while risking performance degradation on previously learned generators. We therefore introduce IncrementDET, a detector that learns each new generator by a process called enrollment. For each generator, IncrementDET trains one linear classifier, which we call a needle, to separate samples of that generator from a fixed set of human reference tracks. Enrolling a new generator adds one needle while the previously constructed needles remain unchanged. A Sidak correction keeps the overall false-positive rate at its target

translated_title: IncrementDET：通过注册机制实现持续式AI生成音乐检测
translated_abstract: AI生成的音乐在音乐流媒体平台上已变得十分常见，听众往往难以将其与人类创作的音乐区分开来。因此需要AI音乐检测技术，但在固定生成器集合上训练的检测器面对未见过的生成器时常常失效。由于新生成器频繁涌现，更新一个通用检测器（即适用于所有生成器的单一模型）通常需要大量训练数据和计算资源，同时还存在在先前已学习生成器上性能退化的风险。为此，我们提出了IncrementDET，一种通过名为“注册”的过程来学习每个新生成器的检测器。对于每个生成器，IncrementDET训练一个线性分类器（我们称之为“针”），将该生成器的样本与一组固定的人类参考曲目区分开来。注册一个新生成器只需添加一个“针”，而先前构建的“针”保持不变。Sidak校正则确保整体误报率保持在目标水平。
tldr: IncrementDET通过为每个AI音乐生成器注册一个独立的线性分类器“针”来实现持续式AI生成音乐检测，无需大规模重训练即可快速适应新生成器，同时保持对已学习生成器的检测性能和稳定的误报率。
en_tdlr: IncrementDET enables continual AI-generated music detection by enrolling each new generator as a separate linear classifier "needle" without retraining, preserving performance on previously learned generators while maintaining a stable overall false-positive rate via Sidak correction.
